==Enemies==
'''Duck''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], an enemy that can stun towers, which first appeared on Wave 8 of Easy mode and Wave 9 of Hard mode in the [[Ducky Revenge Event]].
*[[Chunky Ducky]]
*[[Cool Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]]
*[[Ducky D00M III]]
*[[Ducky Unit (Ducky Revenge)]]
*[[Elite Ducky]]
*[[Evil Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 16 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Explosive Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], an enemy that exploded upon death and first appeared on Wave 13 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Fat Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], a slow enemy that first appeared on Wave 5 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Flying Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], a flying enemy that first appeared on Wave 9 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Grandmother Ducky]]
*[[Long Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], an enemy that could stun towers, that first appeared on Wave 17 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Mega Ducky]]
*[[Missile Ducky]]
*[[Mother Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], a slow high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 8 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Nerd Ducky]]
*[[Operator Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], an enemy that could spawn [[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]] and became a hidden and ghost enemy, that first appeared on Wave 11 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Super Soldier Ducky]]
*[[Spy Ducky (Ducky Revenge)]], a hidden enemy that first appeared on Wave 7 in [[D00M's Revenge]]

It can also refer to these removed event enemies:
*[[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], an enemy that can stun towers, which was spawned by the [[Operator Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]] in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], a fast enemy that first appeared on Wave 3 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], the first enemy that appeared in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Ducky Unit (D00M's Revenge)]]
*[[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 🦆 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 10 in Easy mode [[Eggy Island]], and on Wave 15 in Hard mode [[Eggy Island]]
*[[Explosive Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], an enemy that exploded upon death and first appeared on Wave 13 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Evil Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 16 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Fat Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], a slow enemy that first appeared on Wave 5 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Flying Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], a flying enemy that first appeared on Wave 9 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], an enemy that could stun towers, that first appeared on Wave 17 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Mother Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], a slow high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 8 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Operator Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], an enemy that could spawn [[Agent Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]] and became a hidden and ghost enemy, that first appeared on Wave 11 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
*[[Spy Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Spy Ducky]], a hidden enemy that first appeared on Wave 7 in [[D00M's Revenge]]
